summary: The change extends the pre-admission intake-base refresh in prepareImplementationStart to released dead worker-local candidate rows with a placeholder head and checkpoint, no PR, no published head and no pending intent, and adds available/unavailable base ref tests.

evidence: `src/repair/loop-implementation.ts` lines 403-409 include `unpublishedLocalCandidateShape(record)` in the refresh condition so released dead-candidate rows refresh `record.target.base` before admission.
`tests/repair/loop-issue-intake_test.ts` lines 393-462 seed a placeholder-head dead candidate and prove the model request and reservation use the refreshed SHA2 base with no checkoutBase.
The same test loop proves an unavailable development ref produces a bounded unavailable wait with zero reservations and zero model starts.
